name: groundwork
description: Pick a box on a world map and see what is actually there: real elevation, with the rivers, lakes, climate and vegetation derived from it rather than painted on.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @dharv44/groundwork-core && npm run build -w @dharv44/groundwork-engine && npm run build -w @dharv44/groundwork-builder
scripts.check:types: tsc -b && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/engine/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/builder/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/core/test/tsconfig.json --noEmit
